content.user_title: Control Philips Hue Lights with OpenHue
content.value_statement: Managing Hue lights through chat can be slow without exact CLI commands. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to use OpenHue for lights, rooms, scenes, brightness, and color.
actual_capabilities: Lists Hue lights, rooms, and scenes through OpenHue CLI commands.
Turns individual Hue lights on or off by name.
Controls room power and brightness for supported Hue rooms.
Sets brightness, color temperature, named colors, and RGB values.
Activates named scenes in a selected room.
Provides preset command patterns for bedtime, work, and movie lighting.
limitations: Requires the OpenHue CLI binary to be installed before use.
Requires a Hue Bridge on the same local network.
Initial pairing may require pressing the Hue Bridge button.
Color commands only work with color-capable Hue bulbs.

use_cases.title: Adjust Room Lighting
use_cases.description: Change brightness or power for a room without remembering OpenHue command syntax.

use_cases.title: Activate Focus Scenes
use_cases.description: Start a saved Hue scene for work, reading, or relaxation from an assistant prompt.

use_cases.title: Check Hue Resources
use_cases.description: List available lights, rooms, and scenes before choosing the correct control target.

prompt_templates.title: List My Hue Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my available Hue lights, rooms, and scenes with OpenHue.

prompt_templates.title: Dim a Room
prompt_templates.prompt: Dim the Bedroom room to 30 percent brightness using OpenHue.

prompt_templates.title: Set a Scene
prompt_templates.prompt: Activate the Relax scene in the Bedroom with OpenHue.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Lighting Preset
prompt_templates.prompt: Set the Office for focused work with bright, cool lighting through OpenHue.

output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the Bedroom room and prepares an OpenHue room command to switch it off.

output_examples.input: Make the Office bright and cool for work.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects the Office room, sets full brightness, and uses a cooler color temperature.

output_examples.input: Start movie lighting in the living room.
output_examples.output: The assistant applies a low-brightness living room setting or activates a matching saved scene.

best_practices: Confirm room, light, and scene names before changing several devices.
List Hue resources first when names are unknown or ambiguous.
Use brightness and temperature values supported by the OpenHue CLI.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for non-Hue smart home devices.
Do not assume white-only bulbs support color or RGB commands.
Do not use this skill when the Hue Bridge is unreachable.

faq.question: What does this skill control?
faq.answer: It controls Philips Hue lights, rooms, scenes, brightness, color, and color temperature through the OpenHue CLI.

faq.question: Does it install OpenHue automatically?
faq.answer: The skill declares a Homebrew install option, but the OpenHue CLI must be available before commands can run.

faq.question: Does it work without a Hue Bridge?
faq.answer: No. The skill expects a Hue Bridge on the same local network.

faq.question: Can it control other smart home brands?
faq.answer: No. It is focused on Philips Hue devices supported by OpenHue.

faq.question: Can it change light colors?
faq.answer: Yes, when the target Hue bulb supports color. White-only bulbs cannot use color commands.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
